winners.description: DualCast is a real-time, privacy-preserving AI eSports commentary engine built on a multimodal Vision-Language pipeline (Qwen2.5-VL).

The CareBot is an AI-powered assistant for elderly and patients that monitors health, detects falls or abnormalities, and alerts caregivers instantly. It also manages daily routines, provides reminders, enables voice interaction, offers entertainment, and autonomously assists with navigation and essential tasks.

RESQNET is a decentralized, resilience-first disaster response system designed to function without traditional infrastructure, enabling communication and coordination even during power and network failures.
Overlay AI is an on-screen AI co-pilot that helps users instantly understand, fix, or act on anything visible with a single keystroke.

DeepfakeID is a real-time liveness detection API that analyzes blink patterns, head pose, skin texture, and motion entropy to classify videos as real or fake, targeting secure KYC and onboarding systems.
